en: Tinted view of the harbor and hillside settlement of Chefoo (treaty‑port era Yantai) with small boats on the water and European‑style buildings along the shore. At lower left is a small vignette portrait of a Chinese woman in traditional dress beside a vase of flowers. Captions include the city name and German publisher credit. The back is a multilingual "Postkarte — Carte postale" layout with dotted address lines typical of early postcards.
